crossRefs.note: Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or…
in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have…

translations.web: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
translations.bsb: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.
translations.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
translations.asv: if we are faithless, he abideth faithful; for he cannot deny himself.
